title: Let's Learn English Lesson 13
subtitle: Happy Birthday, William Shakespeare!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 13: Happy Birthday, William Shakespeare! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! In Washington D.C. there are many things to do on a Sunday afternoon. I like to exercise. I like to shop. I like to garden. But today I feel bored. When I feel bored I always look for something unusual to do! I hear music. Let’s go see! What is going on here?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！在华盛顿特区，周日下午有很多事可以做。我喜欢锻炼。我喜欢购物。我喜欢园艺。可今天我觉得无聊。无聊的时候，我总是找点特别的事做！我听到音乐了。我们去看看！这里在干什么？

dialogue.speaker: Rebecca
dialogue.en: It’s a big birthday party for the writer William Shakespeare.
dialogue.zh: 这是作家威廉·莎士比亚的大型生日派对。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is a party for William Shakespeare?
dialogue.zh: 这是给威廉·莎士比亚办的派对？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is a drum band. I never listen to a drum band. But today I am listening to a drum band because it’s Shakespeare’s birthday!
dialogue.zh: 这是鼓乐队。我从来没听过鼓乐队。可今天我在听鼓乐队，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is a puppet show. I never watch puppet shows. But today I am watching a puppet show because it’s Shakespeare’s birthday!
dialogue.zh: 这是木偶戏。我从来不看木偶戏。可今天我在看木偶戏，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: My clothes are usual. His clothes are unusual.
dialogue.zh: 我的衣服很平常。他的衣服不平常。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In Washington, D.C. seeing a politician or even the President is usual. Seeing the Queen of England is very unusual! Your majesty!
dialogue.zh: 在华盛顿特区，见到政客甚至总统都很平常。见到英国女王就非常不平常！女王陛下！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is sword fighting. I never sword fight. But today I am sword fighting because it’s Shakespeare’s birthday!
dialogue.zh: 这是击剑。我从来不击剑。可今天我在击剑，因为今天是莎士比亚的生日！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: There are many things to do in Washington, D.C. -- some usual, some unusual.
dialogue.zh: 在华盛顿特区有很多事可以做——有的平常，有的不平常。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today, I am not bored because … it is William Shakespeare’s birthday!
dialogue.zh: 今天我不无聊了，因为……今天是威廉·莎士比亚的生日！

quiz.prompt: Why is there a big party?
choices: It is a birthday party for William Shakespeare

quiz.prompt: What does Anna say she never watches?
What is very unusual in Washington, D.C.?
